chapter: Chano Pozo, Town Hall and Charlie Parker
title: Parker sitting in at the Royal Roost; the "Asia Minor" bootleg
summary: Parker came as a visitor and played with them; Salazar tells Machito of a bootleg recording of "Asia Minor" from the Royal Roost.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Okay. At that time, you began playing at the Royal Roost, The Club Clque and other places like that. Did Charlie Parker appear on any of those dates with you? Was he on the bill with you?
Yes, he used to come as a visitor and start playing with us like he was getting paid.
Right, because there is a recording of "Asia Minor" which was tape-recorded without your knowledege and it's on the market now; a bootleg recording of "Asia Minor" which sounds very good.
It was recorded at the Royal Roost.
